audit.whatIsWrong: EVEN / 5.5 is defensible at 48.06% over 878 games, but every one of the seven full-layer level rows read 'Skill' while the packet and the content layer both read Orianna/Orianna/Orianna/Orianna/Anivia/Anivia/Anivia. The page rendered two different answers to every level.
audit.why: The split is real and kit-grounded: pre-6 Anivia pays 80-100 mana per Flash Frost on an 11s cooldown with no dash and no escape, so Orianna's 815 ball wins every wave contact; from 6 Glacial Storm plus Crystallize takes the wave and the ground back.
audit.corrected: Full sides moved to Orianna/Orianna/Orianna/Orianna/Anivia/Anivia/Anivia with phases[2..6].why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes was the generic Orianna template: 'level 6 doubles your lane presence; Luden's makes Q-W a third of a health bar'. Level 6 is Anivia's, and the one-third figure has no source.
audit.why: Glacial Storm is 60 mana on a 4/3/2s cooldown — effectively always available — against a 110s Command: Shockwave. That asymmetry, not Luden's, is what decides the midgame here.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-4 yours while she pays 80 mana a Q; 6 is hers on Glacial Storm; late she out-zones you outright.

audit.whatIsWrong: Frostbite's doubling condition was stated only half-way: the page said 'sidestep Flash Frost and her E never doubles' and never mentioned the second trigger.
audit.why: Riot's text: Frostbite deals DOUBLE damage 'if the target was recently hit by Flash Frost OR damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm'. Dodging the Q is not enough — standing anywhere inside her ult arms the same doubled Frostbite, which is the actual reason post-6 trades kill you.
audit.corrected: Both triggers stated in loading, breakdown.mid, report[5].t and tldr.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flagged it directly: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' (sequencingCues 0). breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all.
audit.why: The whole punish window in this lane is one number: Flash Frost is 11/10/9/8/7s while Frostbite is 4s flat. Waiting for her E to be down is a wasted lane; waiting for her Q is the entire plan. Crystallize is 17s and Command: Protect is 9s.
audit.corrected: Step up on Flash Frost's downtime, never on her E which is back every 4s; Crystallize 17s cuts you from your team; Command: Protect 9s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer called Anivia 'he/his' throughout — 'ball placement against his cooldowns', 'his farm path', 'his engage', 'a frozen wave at his tower', 'Make him flinch first'.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists anivia as female. The content layer already used she/her correctly, so the page contradicted itself between panels.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to she/her across tldr, tradeGood, tradeBad, phases[0-1].why, breakdown.wave, dosFull, dontsFull and report[].

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string pasted under 'Q-W his wave contacts on cooldown'; dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string pasted under 'Shockwave a wave when fights are spawning'; dontsFull[0].d read 'That's Anivia's bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers', which names no play and no mechanism.
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed plus filler on three of six bullets.
audit.corrected: Each body rewritten to its own title, grounded in Q at 3s rank 5 versus her 7s, the 815-versus-1075 range gap, and Shockwave's 110s against her 4s ult.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization ended 'Zhonya's vs dive — buy the stopwatch the moment Zed hits 6'.
audit.why: Zed is not in this matchup; it is a leaked line. Against Anivia the purchase that matters is boots, because Glacial Storm's slow is what closes the 650 gap Frostbite needs.
audit.corrected: Boots early — Glacial Storm's slow is what lets Frostbite reach you.

audit.why: The content layer's win condition (own pre-6, then group and make one Shockwave land rather than duel a champion who revives) matches the kit and the level chart.
Not derivable from the kit files; no web research was required for the defects above.

notes: Level chart: all seven full-layer rows read 'Skill' against a packet and a content layer that agree exactly on Orianna/Orianna/Orianna/Orianna/Anivia/Anivia/Anivia. The full layer was moved to them and phases[2..6].why rewritten so no row argues with itself; phases[0].why and phases[1].why already described Orianna winning and needed only the pronoun fix. Content win[0..6] needs no edit. phases[N].rating was deliberately NOT touched — see questionsForUser. Packet defect 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' is addressed: the decisive number is that Frostbite is 4s flat and Flash Frost is 11/10/9/8/7s, so the punish window is her Q, never her E — that now appears in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and tradeGood. Biggest content find: the page only ever gave HALF of Frostbite's doubling condition. Riot's text doubles it after Flash Frost OR after damage from a fully formed Glacial Storm, so 'sidestep the Q' is not sufficient advice post-6 — standing in her ult arms the same doubled Frostbite. Both triggers are now stated.
